name: Defensive Sunder (Combat)
body:
You can sunder weapons used to attack you.

Prerequisite: Str 13, Improved Sunder, Power Attack

Benefit: If a melee weapon attack misses you while you are fighting defensively, using full defense, or using combat expertise, you may make a Sunder maneuver against the weapon as an attack of opportunity.
